source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital Resources
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 179,000 full-time and part-time employees calculated on a full-time equivalent basis.

payroll.label: Annual total compensation of our median employee

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: pay ratio for 2025 is 381 to 1, calculated by dividing Mr. Roberts' 2025 total compensation set forth in the Summary Compensation Table, adjusted as described below, by $92,390, which represents the annual total compensation of our median employee.

notes: Employees: approximate count at December 31, 2025, on a full-time-equivalent basis (FY2025 10-K); this is before the January 2026 Versant separation. Payroll: the 10-K gives no total of salaries and benefits (it names them only as parts of segment 'other' expenses), so the 2026 proxy's 2025 median employee annual total compensation ($92,390) is used. The proxy identified the median from a sample of about 197,828 full-time, part-time, seasonal and temporary employees, without annualizing part-time or seasonal pay, which it says lowers the median.
